title: Jepson Center for the Arts

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Enjoy The Children’s Art Museum at Jepson, The Owens Thomas House & Slave Quarters, and the historic Telfair Academy-all for one low price. This includes all new exhibitions at Jepson, too. Explore over 200 years of art, history, and architecture in the heart of downtown Savannah. Tickets include unlimited admission to all three sites for one week from the date of purchase. To purchase tickets, click here or visit the front desk at any of our three sites. Admission includes unlimited visits to all Telfair sites. Tickets are valid for seven days. Owens-Thomas House & Slave Quarters tours are given at 15-minute intervals. The last tour begins at 4:00pm. services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Whether behind the scenes, in the art studios, or on tour in the galleries, our docents are an integral part of the museum experience and are vital to the development and implementation of all educational tours and programming at Telfair Museums. Volunteer docents serve as visible and important public ambassadors of Telfair Museums, conducting tours and welcoming local and out-of-town visitors. All that is required is a love for art and enthusiasm for meeting new people. Don’t know a lot about art? Don’t worry!
